title: How to Enable Full-Width Homepage Content | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Enable Full-Width Homepage Content Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000079053 In order to display the Homepage Streaming Content full-width please follow these steps: 1. Navigate to My Content -> Web Page Builder: 2. Search for the Homepage and click on Edit: 3. Move to Page Options Tab on the sidebar and select the Full Screen Page Width option: 4. Save the changes. This is what the Homepage streaming content will look like after enabling this setting: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
